title: doc comment for cleanup_tmp_files still says .msg.tmp/.env.tmp but code now matches any .tmp
description: The doc comment on cleanup_tmp_files (line 183-189) says 'removes any .msg.tmp or .env.tmp files'. The round-6 implementation now matches any file whose extension() == "tmp". The comment and the code are now out of sync. A reader or contributor relies on the doc comment to understand the contract; the mismatch will cause confusion and increase the chance of a contributor 'fixing' the code back to the narrower check without realising the intent changed.
